newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-DLJ said to start gaming stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-DLJ said to start gaming stocks.

text.p: -- Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette securities began coverage of three gaming stocks on Monday, according to a trading source.
-- Boyd Gaming Corp was started as a market perform, the source said. Its shares slipped 1/8 to 9-3/4, a new year low, in early trading Monday.
-- Rio Hotel & Casino Inc was initiated with a market perform rating. Its shares closed at 15-1/4 on Friday.
-- Station Casinos Inc was started with an outperform rating, the source said. Its shares closed at 15-1/4 on Friday.
-- Analyst Brian Eggar was not immediately available for comment.
